instructions: Check out baseCommit, apply working-tree.patch with git apply, then copy the contents of added/ into the checkout. Follow base-project build instructions and provide your own Telegram API build settings. Signing credentials and local build outputs are excluded.
buildNote: Release compiled with MSVC and linked using LLD with /DEBUG:NONE. In the generated Telegram.vcxproj remove the 12 explicit lib_crl Object inputs already contained in lib_base.lib, set Release GenerateDebugInformation=false, then use MSBuild LinkToolExe=lld-link.exe and LinkToolPath to the linker directory. Provide the NDK LLVM bin directory on PATH. Verification also used a full Debug build.
